newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHARES CLOSE MIXED, END WINNING STREAK.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHARES CLOSE MIXED, END WINNING STREAK.

text.p: Greek equities traded narrowlly and ran out of steam on Tuesday after the benchmark share index broke out of a well-established trading range around 1,550 points.
Brokers said stocks would start reacting to interim corporate result announcements in the absence of other news capable of stirring the market.

"There are no major news to swing the market to either direction and investors are awaiting for announcements of half-year corporate results," said Costas Panagidis, general manager at Axon Securities.
Investors were seen remaining cautious and focus on stock-picking.
"Traders are not concerned with downside risk but at the same time appear undecided about the market's short-term upside potential," Panagidis said.

"But I see growing interest and discrete stock-picking after a brief period where investors were side-lined," he added. "A clearer trend will be set once turnover starts to average over 20 billion drachmas a day."
The Athens general index inched 0.03 percent or 0.54 points higher to 1,548.18 from Monday's 1,547.64 close, turning back from intra-day highs around 1,560 points.
Trading was delayed 45 minutes due to minor technical adjustments by the Athens bourse and the session was wound up at 1400 local, 1100 gmt.
Industrials and banks gained 0.42 and 0.04 percent respectively while construction shares were down 0.86 percent.
Turnover reached 12.1 billion drachmas on volume of 3.38 million shares with the help of block trades in Viohalko, Alpha Finance and Alpha Leasing .
Decliners led advancers 131 to 77 with 18 shares unchanged on 226 traded.
OTE telecom Global Depository Shares (GDS) were quoted at London's SEAQ International market at $11.50-$11.80. Two GDSs make up one share of OTE.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas, capped at 5,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,118-1,148 drachmas.

The recently launched second Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 6,800 drachmas, capped at 10,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,148-1,208 drachmas. The warrants expire December 16, 1998. Shares of the underlying stock lost 45 drachmas to 6,470.
The Merrill Lynch American call warrant on a basket of 23 Greek equities that are part of the Athens general index was quoted at 607.31-646.08 drachmas. The warrants expire January 9 1998.

The ING Baring Financial Products American style call warrant based on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $70.60-$73.35. The strike price is set at $99.60 and the warrants expire October 8, 1997.

The ING Baring Financial Products American-style call warrant on a basket of six blue-chips denominated in drachmas was quoted at 3,354-3,573 drachmas. The strike price is set at 10,000 drachmas and the warrants expire on February 2, 1998.
The ING Baring American-style second call warrant on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $10.90-N/O. The strike price is set at $110.0 and the warrants expire April 9 1998.

The recently launched ING Baring American-style, drachma- denominated call warrant on the bourse's benchmark index was quoted at 216-247 drachmas. The strike price is set at 1,639 points and the warrants expire May 14 1998. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
